Download drought index data

Source: R/source-drought.R
download_drought.Rd

Dispatch to download_spei(), download_eddi(), or download_usdm(). The selected function validates its arguments, constructs download URLs, and handles previews, downloads, optional extraction, and return values.

Usage

download_drought(
  source = c("spei", "eddi", "usdm"),
  date = c("2020-01-01", "2020-12-31"),
  timescale = 1L,
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  hash = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  max_tries = 3L,
  rate_limit = 2,
  unzip = TRUE,
  remove_zip = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  version = c("2.11", "2.10", "legacy"),
  ...
)

Arguments

source

character(1). "spei" (default), "eddi", or "usdm". Uses base::match.arg(), allowing unambiguous partial matches.

date

character(1 or 2). One date or inclusive range endpoints in "YYYY-MM-DD" format, in either order. EDDI and USDM select Tuesdays within the interval and stop if none occur. Default is c("2020-01-01", "2020-12-31"). Ignored for SPEI, which downloads a complete multi-year file.

timescale

integer(1). Positive accumulation timescale in months, used by SPEI and EDDI. Default is 1L. Ignored for USDM. Input validation does not establish whether the provider has a file for that timescale.

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty output directory. SPEI and EDDI save files directly here. USDM uses zip_files/ for archives and data_files/ for extracted files beneath this directory.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed, including for previews. Downloads and extracted files may require substantial storage. Default is FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return a combined MD5 hash of the output directory instead of the download summary. Uses directory_to_save for SPEI/EDDI and data_files/ for USDM, including existing files. Default is FALSE; ignored when download = FALSE.

show_progress

logical(1). Show file download progress. Default is TRUE. Other status and summary messages may still be printed when FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per file request, including the initial attempt. Must be at least 1. Default is 3L.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Finite, non-negative request-throttling interval in seconds, passed to download_run_method(). Default is 2.

unzip

logical(1). Extract USDM archives into data_files/. Default is TRUE. Ignored for SPEI and EDDI.

remove_zip

logical(1). Remove USDM archives and their zip_files/ directory recursively after extraction, including remaining contents. Requires unzip = TRUE for USDM. Default is FALSE. Ignored for SPEI and EDDI.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE warns and returns a preview after directory creation, without making network requests. Default is TRUE.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns. No command file is generated. Default is FALSE.

version

character(1). SPEI selection: "2.11" (default), "2.10", or "legacy". The last choice uses the unversioned /files/ endpoint; its release is not identified by the URL. Uses base::match.arg(). No automatic fallback between versions occurs. Ignored for EDDI and USDM.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to the selected source function. Its ... argument is currently reserved and ignored.

Value

The selected source function's result, with visibility preserved:

  • With download = FALSE, an invisible list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files.

  • With download = TRUE and hash = FALSE, an invisible download summary containing success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no downloads failed, including when every file was skipped.

  • With download = TRUE and hash = TRUE, a visible character scalar containing the combined MD5 hash of the source's output directory.

Counts describe file downloads, not extraction or scientific validity. Validation or extraction failures can prevent a normal return.

Details

Only arguments relevant to the selected source are forwarded. Common validation occurs once in the source function; this wrapper does not repeat validation, directory creation, or download execution.

Previews create the output directories but make no network requests. They include existing destination files. Actual downloads use download_run_method(), which skips existing non-empty files and reports individual failures. See the source functions for endpoint limitations and extraction behavior.

SPEI retains the flat speiNN.nc filename across versions for compatibility with process_drought(). Existing-file checks do not distinguish versions. The date argument does not subset SPEI downloads; temporal selection is performed during processing.

Note

No authentication is required. SPEI and EDDI provide raster inputs; USDM provides polygon inputs for the downstream drought workflow.

See also

download_spei(), download_eddi(), download_usdm(), process_drought(), calculate_drought()

Author

Insang Song

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_drought(
  source = "spei",
  timescale = 1L,
  version = "2.11",
  directory_to_save = "./data/drought",
  acknowledgement = TRUE
)
download_drought(
  source = "usdm",
  date = c("2020-01-07", "2020-03-31"),
  directory_to_save = "./data/drought",
  acknowledgement = TRUE
)
} # }
